info.title: WiiUStation
info.author: cassiojsl
info.description: PS1 emulator for the Wii U
info.details:
PlayStation (PS1) emulator for the Wii U, based on PCSX-ReARMed.

A standalone app for the Aroma environment (.wuhb). The emulator core is PCSX-ReARMed, linked into the app through the libretro API, so RetroArch is not needed. The menu, video, controllers, covers and saves are WiiUStation's own.

AI use: Co-written with AI.
